charts.title: K2-190 c: orbits around K2-190
charts.description: The orbits of K2-190's planets in this map from above, to scale, with K2-190 c highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

metadata.orbitSource: Mayo et al. 2018 (2018AJ....155..136M), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname MAYO_ET_AL__2018): P 21.574023 d
